title: Demand Paging Simulation
features: Added **demand paging** to a simulated OS shell, loading pages on demand.
Implemented **LRU page replacement**, reducing page faults by ~30%.
Handled **page faults**, process interruption, and virtual-to-physical mapping with 40+ tests.
Enabled **memory sharing** and extended program loading with paging support.

title: Distributed DNS Cache System
features: Built a **DNS routing system** with dynamic domain-to-IP mapping and caching for 1,000+ domains.
Implemented **LRU, LFU, and LIFO eviction** using polymorphism and a custom doubly linked list, reducing lookup latency by ~35%.
Developed **distributed DNS managers** for dynamic load balancing and automatic entry redistribution.
Ensured runtime safety with **exception handling, cache synchronization, and memory-safe allocation**.

title: Optimization and Implementation of the Tower of Hanoi
features: Developed **recursive and non-recursive solutions** for the Tower of Hanoi puzzle
Implemented efficient **cache management and memory access** techniques for both algorithms.
Utilized **MARS tools** to measure performance, including cache misses, memory accesses, and instruction count.
Conducted performance analysis with different **cache configurations** to optimize execution speed.

title: CSV-Backend Database Development
features: Developed a lightweight database engine with custom **in-memory data structures** and pointer-based record management.
Implemented low-level **CSV file I/O** functions for persistent storage and data synchronization.
Designed a **command-line interface (CLI)** for user interaction, handling command parsing, validation, and error recovery.
Managed **dynamic memory allocation and resizing** with malloc/realloc to support growing datasets efficiently.
